operations.name: attach
operations.label: Attach a pull request to Session
operations.description: Connect the calling Session to a GitHub pull request it produced, so the Session's Changes show it. Attaching it again changes nothing.

reference.description: The pull request: owner/repo#123, its GitHub URL, or just its number for the Project's own repository.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

again.description: Attach a pull request that was detached from the Session. Pass it only when the person asks for it back.

operations.name: discover
operations.label: Find the pull requests of the Session's branch
operations.description: Look on GitHub for the pull requests, open, merged or closed, opened from the calling Session's current branch, and attach each one found that was not detached from the Session. Safe to repeat: earlier attached pull requests stay. Answers found, detached (every one found was detached from the Session, so none was attached), no-match, branchless, not-github or unavailable.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

unlessAttached.description: Skip the look, and answer attached, when the Session already has a pull request. Argo sets it when a Turn ends.

operations.name: detach
operations.label: Detach a pull request from Session
operations.description: Remove one pull request from the calling Session's Changes, for one that does not belong to it. The Session's other pull requests stay, and the pull request itself is untouched on GitHub.

reference.description: The pull request: owner/repo#123, its GitHub URL, or just its number for the Project's own repository.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

operations.name: automationSet
operations.label: Turn an automation on or off for a pull request
operations.description: Turn Auto-fix, Auto-merge or Auto-archive on or off for one pull request attached to the calling Session. Auto-fix prompts the Session once for each failed Check, merge conflict and review comment from a trusted author on the pull request, and turns itself off after three Prompts on one commit with no new push; it is only for pull requests the signed-in account opened. Auto-merge is GitHub's own: it merges when the pull request is ready, or at once when it is ready already, with the first method the repository allows (squash, merge, rebase), and shows whatever GitHub reports. Auto-archive archives the Session once the pull request is merged or closed and no other attached pull request is open, waiting while a Turn runs. An Agent's call to turn Auto-merge on or off asks the person first; Auto-fix and Auto-archive do not ask.

reference.description: The pull request: owner/repo#123, its GitHub URL, or just its number for the Project's own repository.

kind.description: Which automation: fix (prompt the Session about each failed Check, conflict and trusted review comment), merge (GitHub's auto-merge) or archive (archive the Session once the pull request is merged or closed).

on.description: True to turn it on, false to turn it off.

firstEnable.description: For a newly opened pull request, enable Auto-fix only if it has no setting yet. Returns the current setting on replay.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

operations.name: list
operations.label: List the Session's pull requests
operations.description: Read the pull requests attached to the calling Session, with their title, stage, branch and totals as GitHub reports them.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

operations.name: files
operations.label: Read the files of an attached pull request
operations.description: Read one page of the files a pull request attached to the calling Session changes, against that pull request's own base and head on GitHub, never the Session's Checkout. Answers the files, the pull request's totals and the cursor of the next page.

reference.description: The pull request: owner/repo#123, its GitHub URL, or just its number for the Project's own repository.

cursor.description: The page to read, as the previous answer's nextCursor; the first when absent.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

operations.name: diff
operations.label: Read one file's patch of an attached pull request
operations.description: Read the patch of one file a pull request attached to the calling Session changes, as a git patch against that pull request's own base, never the Session's Checkout.

reference.description: The pull request: owner/repo#123, its GitHub URL, or just its number for the Project's own repository.

path.description: The file's path in the pull request.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

operations.name: refresh
operations.label: Read the Session's pull requests again
operations.description: Ask GitHub again for the pull requests attached to the calling Session, now: the retry after signing in again or after a failed read. Returns what list does.

sessionId.description: The Session the pull request belongs to; the calling Session when it is an Agent's own run.

capabilities.reason: Reads pull requests as the signed-in person, through the Account the Issue tracker provides.
